messages.subject: Lyra - warranty caps - your steer
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

Hargrove have asked for a 3x founder warranty cap (was 2x) and a £200k claims basket. Our recommendation is to settle the founder cap at 2.5x and the basket at £175k, and concede the 30-month survival, which is reasonable. This caps each founder's exposure well below the value of their holding and is consistent with what we agreed on Kestrel.

Are you content for us to propose that?

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
